segments.title: Visitors aboard Mikasa
segments.body: Visitors of all ages gave Mikasa a lively atmosphere on both days of the visit. The staff provided a welcoming reception aboard the preserved warship. Japanese visitors and personnel from the U.S. Seventh Fleet came specifically to meet the ShipShape team. These encounters made the ship a meeting place for an international group of visitors during the trip.

evidence.note: The account describes visitors of all ages aboard Mikasa on two consecutive days, welcoming staff, and Japanese visitors and U.S. Seventh Fleet personnel who came to meet the ShipShape team.

segments.summary: Mikasa was busy with visitors of all ages on two consecutive days, including Japanese guests and U.S. Seventh Fleet personnel who came to meet the ShipShape team.
